0.original: Though gripped by sadness, Sphene spurs herself to action.

28.original: Clear the way of monstrous intruders.

48.original: I will hold on to Geode's gun... If you could take the soul cell, please...

49.original: We should return to the Backroom. Shale and the others need to know what happened.

50.original: Yes, I'll ask Wayakkwe to meet us there as well.

52.original: I got back control of the sentries...probably around the same time Calyx left. I'm sorry, I couldn't stop him...

53.original: We made a swift patrol of the other levels, and confirmed that Calyx had carried out a number of targeted attacks. All to harvest more aether, it seems...

54.original: I assume you know better by now, but I hope you're not planning to try anything alone. We are all here with you.

55.original: I've spoken with Wuk Lamat. They've cut their meeting short to deal with the aftermath of this latest violence.

56.original: They brought back Geode's gun... Its rounds were spent an' its barrel was scorched, so ye can be sure he went down fightin'.

57.original: I am told that the members tasked with keeping residents safe returned with the body of their comrade. They all risk so much...

58.original: Another comrade gone. Some days it's almost more than I can bear.

59.original: Geode was... He was an older brother to Nostalgia and me.

60.original: Shale knew him longer, though, and is surely taking it the hardest. And that's on top of what happened with Cahciua...

61.original: Do you think you could check on her? See how she's doing? She's like to put on a brave face if it's me or my sister.

62.original: Oh, we have Isadora and Milos under guard, so...that's one less thing to worry about.

64.original: We need to press on with the hunt for Calyx, but I can't seem to focus. I should be better than this, I know...

66.original: Is there anything I can do?

67.original: As you said, you need time to work through it.

68.original: You can't help yourself, can you? Still, I appreciate the concern.

69.original: You're right. I ought to heed my own words. As it stands, I'm of no use to anyone.

70.original: Cahciua used to say the best thing to do with grief was to let it all out.

71.original: So, I think I'll take myself over to Earthen Sky and say my good-byes to Geode...

72.original: Why don't you come along? I could use someone to blubber to if you've a shoulder to spare.

73.original: Right, then... Let's get out of Everkeep for a bit.

74.original: It's a fair trek on foot, so I've arranged for a couple of air-wheelers.

75.original: They've had their communications modules removed, so even Calyx shouldn't be able to seize control of them. Say the word, and we'll set off.

76.original: Ready? We'll be flying close to the pylons, so follow my lead.

78.original: These air-wheelers are Genolt's babies. You won't find a smoother ride in all of Everkeep.

79.original: For years now, I've been taking one out for a turn whenever I needed to lighten my mood.

80.original: Sometimes Geode would come along, too, and we'd end up racing.

81.original: Does that surprise you? Our friendship always had a competitive edge.

82.original: We would often talk about how, one day, we might fly our wheelers outside the dome...

83.original: ...Almost there. Be sure the ground is clear before you touch down.

84.original: Phew... That's helped clear my head a touch.

85.original: You know, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, you might be the first person I've ridden with who wasn't an Oblivion recruit.

86.original: ...As far as I remember, at least. The memories from my regulator days aren't exactly reliable.

87.original: Come on, let's head inside. Hopefully the way will be clear of pests today...

90.original: We can usually avoid such encounters, but sometimes they wander in and block the only path.

91.original: Not that it slowed you down at all. I've never seen you fight up close before, and the surveillance feed clearly didn't do it justice.

92.original: Ahem. Hopefully that keeps the route clear for a while. Shall we?

93.original: ...I appreciate you helping me through this.

94.original: And not only the grief. You've helped me see that my comrades mean even more to me than I realized.

96.original: I'll be spending every waking moment working to bring Calyx to account for his crimes.

97.original: I'll do my part, then you do yours. Oblivion needs you.
